2.0.0.title: Native components. A shared foundation.
2.0.0.summary: Bring document workflows directly into Angular, Vue and React applications, with a shared browser-safe workspace controller.

1.1.1.title: From extraction to answers.
1.1.1.summary: Find specific fields, ask document questions and review structured results alongside the source. Includes the expanded hosted workspace.

0.1.0.title: The first building blocks.
0.1.0.summary: The initial public npm release introduced the core extraction library, service SDK and React workspace embed.

sync.title: Recover sync after a database restore
sync.summary: The developer preview now detects stale checkpoints and rebuilds the local server cache after a PostgreSQL restore.
notes: Preserve queued edits and conflict drafts while replaying the restored change feed.
Surface edits based on revisions missing from the backup as conflicts.
Upgrade both the client SDK and self-hosted reference server to use restore recovery.

sync.title: A refreshed npm listing
sync.summary: A documentation-only update to the PageSignal Sync developer preview.
notes: Add the PageSignal Sync cover to the npm README.
Update the README installation instructions for the public package.

sync.title: Offline-first sync developer preview
sync.summary: The first public release of PageSignal Sync, a standalone TypeScript SDK for offline-first web apps.
notes: Persist local edits in IndexedDB and subscribe to changes.
Resume queued writes on reconnect and recover from conflicting edits.
Run the React, Angular and Vue inventory examples with an optional Node.js and PostgreSQL sync server.
